Of Dartmouth, Massachusetts, son of George Soule and grandson of the Mayflower passenger George Soule.
With his wife Hannah he had at least six children recorded there between 1694 and 1710,
the eldest Hannah (1 June 1694) , several entered in the Friends' (Quaker) meeting records;
a son William Jr. married in the meeting in March 1718.
Wife of William Soule of Dartmouth, Massachusetts, and mother of at least six children recorded there from 1694 to
1710, among them Hannah (1694) , who married Joseph Holway of Sandwich.
The Mayflower Society identifies her as Hannah Eaton, daughter of Benjamin Eaton and Sarah Hoskins;
older books called her Hannah Brewster.
